options.name: maxBlockSize
options.description: Maximum block size as a CSS length (sets --aui-scroll-area-max-block-size).

options.name: shadows
options.description: Fade the edges where more content exists.

properties.name: edges
properties.description: Edges with hidden content ({ top, bottom, left, right }).

properties.name: overflowing
properties.description: Whether the content overflows (the region is then focusable).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove classes, data attributes, observers, and restore the element's own attributes.

contentAreas.name: content
contentAreas.description: The element's own children; they stay in place.

cssClasses.name: data-aui-scroll-top | -bottom | -left | -right
cssClasses.description: Present while content is hidden at that edge.
